verdict.rationale: Highnote exposes a documented GraphQL API (with interactive code explorer), an official Node.js SDK wrapping it, webhooks, and a test environment mirroring live functionality, all of which let an AI-native user drive the product programmatically end-to-end including agentic card issuance workflows. missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s on standard OpenAPI paths) and independent third-party corroboration of API usability beyond vendor docs.
